name: Revenge So Sweet
source:
Are love and hate closer than we thought?

In a world where you were deceived (̶d̶i̶s̶p̶o̶s̶e̶d̶ ̶o̶f̶)̶, would you be able to rise again and brandish your sword for the sake of your loved ones? 

Will you be strong enough to withstand his gaze?
12 Moons ago, you fell in love with the Imperial prince and confessed.

Drunk on love, you used to give him your everything without a care in the world, thinking he'd do the same with you. However, one day, your lover changed and killed everyone you cared for, using what you gave him to his advantage, only to then turn his back on you and rendering you useless.

After getting disposed of by your so called lover, you thought everything had ended until you woke up right before you met him.

Now driven by hate, you swear you'll destroy him and maybe forge yourself a better fate.

[From [url=https://jems-gemme.itch.io/revenge-so-sweet]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
爱与恨是否比我们想象的更近？

在一个被欺骗的世界里(̶d̶i̶s̶p̶o̶s̶e̶d̶̶o̶f̶)̶，你还能为了亲人重新站起来，挥舞剑吗？

你有足够的力量承受他的目光吗？
十二个月前，你爱上了皇子并告白了。

你曾经沉迷于爱情，把自己的一切都给了他，无忧无虑，以为他也会对你做同样的事情。然而，有一天，你的爱人利用你给予他的优势，改变并杀死了你所关心的每一个人，结果却背弃了你，让你变得毫无用处。

被所谓的爱人处理掉之后，你以为一切都结束了，直到你在遇见他之前醒来。

现在，在仇恨的驱使下，你发誓要摧毁他，也许还能为自己创造更好的命运。

[来自[url=https://jems-gemme.itch.io/revenge-so-sweet]Itch.io[/url]]
